version.description: Semver of this rule's check logic — see spec §3

category.description: Rule category (25 total): 18 legacy + 7 v0.4 semantic (pricing, rate_limits, error_semantics, retry_semantics, sandbox, versioning, agent_policy)

severity.description: Rule severity: critical (agents cannot proceed, triggers total ≤ 30 floor), high (triggers category floor), medium (normal), low (informational). v0.4 adds critical — see spec §A.3

pillar.description: Optional pillar override — if absent, pillar is derived from category via the canonical map (spec v0.2 §A.8)

counted_in_score.description: If false, this rule does not contribute to score calculation

applicability.description: Optional applicability condition — if absent, rule always applies

description.description: Human-readable description of when this rule applies

type.description: Check type (9 total): http_fetch, schema_validation, exact_match, cross_evidence, http_probe, content_parse, json_rpc, header_check, semantic_validation (v0.4: pure function parsing structured sources for semantic criteria, no LLM)

sources.description: Array of source identifiers to fetch/compare (for http_fetch, cross_evidence)

match_keys.description: Keys to match when type = exact_match or cross_evidence

conflict_when.description: Condition expression describing when sources conflict (for cross_evidence)

target.description: Target path or URL for http_fetch / schema_validation

semantic.description: Semantic criterion id — required when type = semantic_validation (references SEMANTIC_CHECKERS registry)

check.description: Check definition — how the rule is evaluated

eligible.description: Whether AgentBadge can generate a fix for this rule

type.description: Fix type: deterministic (safe to auto-generate), assisted (requires human confirm/edit/reject), none (not fixable by AgentBadge)

note.description: Additional context about the fix approach

fix.description: Fix definition — how a failing rule can be remediated

display_question.description: Agent-perspective question for GAP display (e.g. 'What does a call cost?')

gap_type.description: Optional gap type override — if absent, DEFAULT_GAP_TYPE_BY_CATEGORY[category] applies (spec v0.5 §8.1)

fix_hint.description: Optional fix hint override — if absent, FIX_HINT_BY_GAP_TYPE[type] applies (spec v0.5 §8.3). Conservative wins when mixed.
